name: duracelltomi/gtm4wp
description: The most popular Google Tag Manager plugin for WordPress

scripts-descriptions.test:doc-links: Probes gtm4wp.com for every settings-screen help link: page reachable without a redirect, option anchor present. Needs the network, so it is outside the unit suite and outside CI - run it before a release (upstream registry U107).
scripts-descriptions.generate:phone-table: Regenerates src/Modules/WooCommerce/CountryPhoneData.php and its test corpus from Google libphonenumber's numbering-plan metadata. Fetches over the network; for an offline run pass a local copy: php tools/generate-phone-table.php /path/to/PhoneNumberMetadata.xml. Run it before a release and commit the result (upstream registry U110).
